cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose Me
cards.instruction: Make yourself the choice over another person, plan, or obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come to my birthday instead of the concert. I've planned dinner before dancing, so nobody has to call crisps a meal.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've already bought two tickets. My friend expects a night out.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Bring her. Two people can change plans without cancelling an entire friendship; I'll set another place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She'll only come if there's room to dance, not just music in your kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Quite right. I'll move the table and mark a clear floor. Now can you choose an evening with someone who has considered where your feet go?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 meal planning suggests competence but A3 corrects a friendship-catastrophe B never asserted; A5 mostly accepts B better planning rather than demonstrating S03.

relationship.evidence: B4 contributes the actual dance requirement, making B appear the more qualified planner.

heightening.evidence: A5 solves the obstacle but asks for credit for considering it after B supplied it, without a clear intentional appropriation.

specificity.evidence: A1 birthday versus concert is clear; crisps and cancelled friendship are unsupported comparisons.
